propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by their canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key, though rebar show correctly resolves these identifiers
The _haystack function excludes ticket identifiers from the searchable text, limiting search to only title, description, tags, and comment bodies
Users searching with an identifier (e.g. 'REB-1654') receive empty results and may incorrectly conclude the ticket does not exist
Identifier matching must be case-insensitive so both uppercase and lowercase queries ('REB-1654' and 'reb-1654') surface the same bound ticket
The search_states reducer must remain pure; Jira key enrichment must happen in the caller search_state by building a ticket_id->jira_key map from the binding store once before calling search_states
